workload.concurrency_axis_semantics: target offered trace-workflow concurrency; arrivals are fixed across policies and do not react to simulator completion
workload.arrival_schedule: seeded offered-load schedule: launch min(C,N), launch one pending workflow at each projected trace-lifespan completion, preserve scaled within-workflow relative offsets; schedule is policy-independent
workload.concurrency_measurement_interval: from the 40th projected trace-lifespan completion (controller stabilization prefix) to the last workflow launch; drain reported separately
workload.highest_concurrency_selection_rationale: C=224 was selected before performance results solely to make six periodic AIMD update opportunities through t=180s and at least five tagged steady samples structurally observable across all ten projected schedules; alpha=0 and performance advantage remain diagnostics, not gates
workload.fault_horizon: complete run including startup, steady interval, and drain; idle/ineffective events retained

failure.worker_replacement_delay_semantics: pressure persists until t+60s; repair event then re-enables future HBM admission for that worker, while invalidated old copies stay invalid and no re-protection occurs; delay is not added directly to request recovery latency
failure.primary_failure_type: single physical GPU-shard fail-now counterfactual keyed by (logical source rank, TP/PP shard rank): estimate recovery for that logical rank's active source request; conservatively invalidate and block the affected logical replica's aggregate Peer-HBM protection until the latest rank-level repair; the failed request's separately bound peer target is not failed by the same event, but its old Peer-HBM copy may already be unavailable after an earlier uptime failure; all DRAM copies survive; do not re-protect
failure.failure_execution_boundary: not executed worker replacement, queue outage, or complete fail-stop rescheduling
failure.history_reporting: A and nonzero-rate B separately report repeated physical (source rank, shard rank) history, current versus ever-failed conservative logical replica-target outage, prior bound-target unavailability, and cumulative old-copy invalidation; exact rate-zero B and C are failure-free normal-state references
failure.target_failover_evidence_boundary: The source implementation and current design require atomic healthy standby rotation with subsequent chunks admitted to the replacement target. This large-scale DES does not migrate per-target runtime/controller/DRAM state and therefore retains natural prior-target invalidation/repair only as a conservative no-standby-rotation sensitivity; it must not claim complete current-design target failover.

estimand_a_uptime_poisson_incidence.name: full-horizon uptime-Poisson per-workflow max-overrun join-harm surrogate
estimand_a_uptime_poisson_incidence.aggregation: for each workflow, take the maximum policy-independent actual-Slack overrun across its effective failed requests; workflows without an effective failed request contribute zero; report the mean over all 393 workflows

estimand_b_active_source_fault_condition.sampling_frame: policy-independent base-schedule active-source GPU-shard time with at least one complete sealed chunk
estimand_b_active_source_fault_condition.sampling: 64 equal cumulative exposure strata; one seeded uniform point per stratum
estimand_b_active_source_fault_condition.formal_ci_unit: paired seed mean over 64 strata; outer paired-seed bootstrap only
estimand_b_active_source_fault_condition.state_semantics: at failure_rate=0 probes observe a failure-free normal state; at nonzero rates the same policy-independent tuples query that rate's live state after any preceding uptime Poisson invalidation/repair history

estimand_c_single_fault_normal_state_eli.name: single-fault normal-state eligible hazard-integrated additive burden
estimand_c_single_fault_normal_state_eli.reference_state: same policy and seed at exact matching failure_rate=0 scenario
estimand_c_single_fault_normal_state_eli.formal_ci_unit: ten matched seed-level 64-strata means with paired outer-seed bootstrap only

reuse_bin_contract.fraction: clip(input_reuse_tokens / prompt_tokens, [0,1]); prompt_tokens=0 is NA and rejected by this workload

simulated_compute_profile.provenance: synthetic preregistered coefficient; not hardware evidence
synthetic preregistered coefficient; not hardware evidence

models.coefficient_evidence_boundary: synthetic preregistered service coefficients; not physical calibration or measured inference latency
models.coefficient_sensitivity_scope: the preregistered Qwen3-8B versus Qwen3-32B model/PP axis changes all declared setup, prefill, decode, KV-size, and topology coefficients together; no isolated physical coefficient claim

cluster.peer_hbm_quota_unit: GiB per physical GPU/model shard; logical DP target aggregate multiplies by TP*PP
cluster.store_dram_quota_unit: GiB per physical stage partition/model shard; logical DP target aggregate multiplies by TP*PP

bandwidth.network_axis_semantics: end-to-end effective path rate; runner maps all listed paths to the scenario value
bandwidth.pipeline_lane_semantics: per-stage independent effective rate; PP=4 has four stage lanes in aggregate and shared-NIC contention is not modeled
bandwidth.provenance: synthetic effective path sweep; 10 GB/s central is 100GbE-class, 1/20/40 GB/s are sensitivity points; not hardware evidence

algorithm3.initial_sample_semantics: t=0 is a telemetry-only snapshot at initial alpha with stable counter zero; it is not an AIMD update
algorithm3.periodic_update_semantics: only positive-time periodic windows apply AIMD, and only when Algorithm 3 is enabled
algorithm3.direct_driver: per-target primary-serving pressure and stable headroom

algorithm1_sensitivity.current_design_prediction_semantics: for each scenario and request/tool boundary, recompute exact actual suffix remaining and visible-frontier CPM from realized service for endpoint labels; independently scale workflow-disjoint central cross-fit remaining predictions by the current request's causal visible scenario/central service proxy, then apply exact CPM at the complete currently visible frontier; at a later fault, decrement boundary Slack by elapsed time rather than recomputing the concurrently evolving residual DAG
algorithm1_sensitivity.scenario_prediction_visible_service_prox: declared model setup/prefill/decode coefficients over current projected prompt, current projected reuse, and effective requested output cap min(protocol cap, model context minus projected prompt); realized output and actual suffix truth are forbidden
algorithm1_sensitivity.actual_slack_label_semantics: policy-independent actual-duration-derived boundary-CPM Slack label with elapsed due-time decrement: max(boundary_actual_slack_ms - elapsed_since_arrival_ms, 0)
algorithm1_sensitivity.ground_truth_word_boundary: ground truth denotes an offline policy-independent duration label only; it is not an exact fault-time concurrent-branch residual-DAG recomputation
algorithm1_sensitivity.multiplier_application: after scenario-specific actual and base-predicted CPM Slack: max(actual + m * (predicted - actual), 0); m=1 directly selects base prediction without reading actual Slack

structural_ablation_contract.design: hierarchical structural 2^3 closure, not three orthogonal independent switches
structural_ablation_contract.reason: when Algorithm 2 is disabled the adapter follows StaticIndependent admission and does not consume Slack, so toggling Algorithm 1 cannot affect decisions
